```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ellmer)
library(rvat)
library(rvatData)
library(DBI)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggsignif)
library(patchwork)
outdir <- tempdir()
gdb <- gdb(rvat_example("rvatData.gdb"))
data_complete <- readRDS(here("data/data_complete.rds"))
data <- data_complete |>
  filter(model == "qwen3:8b")
```

```{r scoring}
data$EM <- ifelse(
  !is.na(data$query) &
  !is.na(data$gold_truth_no_AS) &
  data$query == data$gold_truth_no_AS,
  1,
  0
)

EX_scorer <- function(query, gold_truth) {
  output_query <- tryCatch(
    dbGetQuery(gdb, query),
    error = function(e) NULL  # Return NULL if query fails
  )
  
  output_gold_truth <- tryCatch(
    dbGetQuery(gdb, gold_truth),
    error = function(e) NULL  # Return NULL if query fails
  )
  
  question_ex <- isTRUE(all.equal(output_gold_truth, output_query, check.names = FALSE))
  if (question_ex == TRUE) {
  return(1)}
  else {
    return(0)}
}

data$EX <- map2_int(data$query, data$gold_truth, EX_scorer)
data |> filter(EX == 0 & is.na(timeout)) |>
  dplyr::count(question_nr)

data|> filter(question_nr == 4 & EX == 0 & is.na(timeout)) |>
  select(prompt, replicate, query, gold_truth, assistant_text)
query <- data$query[data$question_nr == 11 & data$replicate == 3]
gold <- data$gold_truth[data$question_nr == 11 & data$replicate == 1]
output_query <- dbGetQuery(gdb, query)
output_gold <- dbGetQuery(gdb, gold)

data$YES <- case_when(
    data$EX == 1 ~ 1,
    data$question_nr == 6 & data$replicate == 3 ~ 1,
    data$question_nr == 7 & data$replicate == 1 ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ 0  # Default case
  )
write_rds(data, here("data/data_scored.rds"))
```
Gets yes score:
3rd rep 6
1st rep 7

Question 8 is not split into two categories: hetero and homozygous, but is the correct amount. The question is probably not specific enough. 

Question 11 rep 3 is incomplete summary

Question 16 rep 1 gives answer, but to subjective question

Question 17 is correct in that it filters to show no results. But it should know that high impact and synonymous can't go together. 
## Table per question
```{r table_sum, echo=FALSE}
data_sum <- data |> 
  group_by(question_nr, type_question) |>
  summarise(replicates = n(),
            EM_percentage = round(((sum(EM)/replicates)*100), digits = 0),
            EX_percentage = round(((sum(EX)/replicates)*100), digits = 0),
            YES_percentage = round(((sum(YES)/replicates)*100), digits = 0) 
            )
```
## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r plots, echo=FALSE, fig.height=9, fig.width=12}
plot_data_tidy <- data_sum |>
  pivot_longer(cols = EM_percentage:YES_percentage, 
               names_to = "score_type",
               values_to = "score_percentage")

plot_reps <- data_sum |>
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(question_nr), y = replicates)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Number of replicates per question",
       x = "Question number",
       y = "Number of replicates") 

plot_lookup <- plot_data_tidy |>
  filter(type_question == "lookup") |>
           ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(question_nr), 
                      y = score_percentage,
                      fill = score_type)) +
           geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
           labs(title = "Positive scores in lookup questions",
                x = "Question number",
                y = "Percentage positive scores") 

plot_analytical <- plot_data_tidy |>
  filter(type_question == "analytical") |>
           ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(question_nr), 
                      y = score_percentage,
                      fill = score_type)) +
           geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
           labs(title = "Positive scores in analytical questions",
                x = "Question number",
                y = "Percentage positive scores") +
  ylim(0,100)

plot_nc <- plot_data_tidy |>
  filter(type_question == "nc") |>
           ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(question_nr), 
                      y = score_percentage,
                      fill = score_type)) +
           geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
           labs(title = "Positive scores in negative control questions",
                x = "Question number",
                y = "Percentage positive scores")

(plot_reps + plot_lookup)/(plot_analytical + plot_nc) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")


```
